subject: Kickoff: MI-maximization study → objective guidance for retrieval encoders
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kickoff for the MI representation-learning effort. Our open-source companion study showed that mutual information maximization alone doesn't explain representation quality — estimator and architecture choices dominate. Teams across graphs-retrieval still pick contrastive objectives by folklore. The deliverable: replicate the study at scale, extend it to our retrieval-encoder setups, and publish an opinionated internal guide ("use this objective/estimator for this data regime") backed by numbers.

Plan: the original suite ran at batch size 128 averaged over 20 runs — a single run takes ~2 hours, so the notebook path is fine for smoke tests, but the full 20-run replication plus our retrieval extensions needs a standalone job on real accelerators. Milestones: harness stood up by end of April, replication done by mid-June, guide published before window close 06-22.

Compute plan from your side when ready.

Anders
